lexical.reason: Middle-resolution compromise: stronger diversity and stability than Initial, avoids Fine-grained fragmentation and Coarse-grained's large generic cluster. Accept lower coverage than Initial and lower diversity/stability than Coarse-grained.
lexical.alternative: Initial for finer detail/coverage; Coarse-grained for broad-theme sensitivity.

semantic.reason: Retains 64 rather than 36 topics and 158 more assigned units than Coarse-grained, with similar aligned stability. Accept lower coherence/diversity than Coarse-grained; retain more subject resolution and coverage.
semantic.alternative: Coarse-grained is the strongest broad-theme alternative, not a failed configuration.

selection_method: Qualitative evidence-based trade-off assessment, not a maximized composite score or significance claim. See docs/FOUR_CONFIGURATION_FINDINGS.md.
expert_validation: pending; recommendations provisional; no expert scores inferred
known_limitations: Intrinsic in-sample metrics and three UMAP seeds; representation uncertainty and held-out generalization are not tested.
Mixed, procedural and OCR-heavy clusters remain under the unchanged preprocessing.
Temporal alignment penalizes splits/merges and includes shared outlier mass; not historical ground truth.
2016-2025 archive is uneven; only 32 source documents in 2025.
Validated frozen embedding cache was reused; current fit timings are not cold end-to-end Legal-BERT cost.
